name: drop
description: Daily domain tracker PWA - Sleep, Fitness, Mind, Spirit

scripts.test: echo 'Tests require running dev server. Run: npm run test:manual'
scripts.test:manual: echo 'DOM tests: Open http://localhost:3000/testing/pages/index.html' && echo 'Visual tests: Start server with npm run dev, then run npm run test:visual'
scripts.test:visual: echo 'Visual tests require running dev server first. Run: npm run dev' && playwright test --config testing/playwright.config.js
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run format:check
